notes.title: Patch #4
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Removed the starting trap (in front of the machine) to make the start smoother and reduce the number of potential blockages as the player progresses.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch #2
notes.content: - Added objects in the final room to make it easier to access with loops

notes.title: Patch #1
notes.content:
[h2][b]Patch[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed tokens that were incorrectly saved in the inventory
[*] Fixed the double appearance of the starting bag after restarting the game after passing it through the crate
[*] Fixed green items that were destroyed in a white bag on the ground or in the inventory
[*] Fixed the bug that prevented the elevator from giving tokens more than once
[*] Fixed traps that reappeared functional after being used
[*] When restarting the game, the loading time has been shortened
[*] Token batches have been removed and replaced with individual tokens
[/list]

If you find a bug, please report it in the discussions or by email.

notes.title: IT'S THE BIG DAY! 🚀
notes.content:
[p]After months of work, doubts, and re-motivation boosts, [b]Endless Mind[/b] is finally available on [b]Steam[/b]! 🔥You can now dive into this unique escape game that's sure to knock you out![/p][p][/p][p]Experience epic moments, explore with curiosity and strategy this labyrinth that's just waiting for you! Whether you're a casual player or a tryharder, there's something for you here ːsteammockingː.  
Get ready to start the loop...[/p][p][/p][p]Don't hesitate to share your feedback, streams, and screenshots 😁[/p][p]👉 Available [b]NOW[/b] on Steam![/p][p]Good luck 😏[/p]
